scope: For TroyScripts resources sending Discord webhook screenshots while Electron AntiCheat resourceProtection is enabled.
intro: Electron AntiCheat is optional and is not a required TroyScripts dependency. If you do not use Electron, these whitelist steps do not apply. If a script captures screenshots via ts_bridge, whitelist each resource involved in that screenshot chain.

table.name: The relevant script
table.condition: Each installed resource that uses the screenshot feature; use its exact resource folder name.

table.name: screenshot-basic
table.condition: When the screenshot feature uses screenshot-basic.

table.name: ts_bridge
table.condition: When screenshots are processed via ts_bridge.

steps: Open the Electron AntiCheat dashboard and select your FiveM server.
Open Settings and navigate to Resources → Resource based protections.
Find resourceProtection and open its settings using the gear icon.
Add each required resource separately to the resource whitelist. Use exact resource names, including dashes and underscores.
Save and apply the changes. Follow any restart or reload instructions for your Electron version.
Reconnect to your FiveM server and test the screenshot feature.

example.lead: For ts_hostage sending screenshots through ts_bridge and screenshot-basic:
example.caution: Do not enter a folder group such as [troyscripts] or a wildcard like ts_*. Add each relevant resource separately. Whitelisting only screenshot-basic is not sufficient if Electron blocks the calling resource or ts_bridge.

checks: The affected resource, screenshot-basic and — when used — ts_bridge are running.
Screenshot capture is enabled in the script configuration and the correct Discord webhook is configured.
Perform an in-game action known to generate a screenshot.
Confirm that the Discord message includes the image in the expected channel.
If it fails, inspect Electron detection logs, the FiveM server console and the player's F8 console.

troubleshooting.title: Text arrives, but no screenshot
troubleshooting.answer: Check that every resource involved is whitelisted. A text-only message may be a fallback; it does not confirm that screenshot capture worked.

troubleshooting.title: Electron reports antiIllegalTrigger
troubleshooting.answer: The event ts_bridge:screenshot:result was detected in an earlier test. Verify ts_bridge is on the resourceProtection whitelist and that changes were applied. If it remains blocked, ask Electron support to inspect the specific detection. Do not disable antiIllegalTrigger globally.

troubleshooting.title: No Electron detection, but the image is still missing
troubleshooting.answer: Inspect the screenshot and upload errors. An invalid webhook, media upload error or network failure may be unrelated to whitelisting.

troubleshooting.title: Is a player or admin whitelist sufficient?
troubleshooting.answer: No. This procedure requires the resource whitelist, not a player or administrator exception. No additional Electron export is needed in the script.

notes: This guide concerns whitelisting the screenshot integration resources, not disabling other anti-cheat protections.
Menu names and the gear icon may differ between Electron versions or languages. Look for resourceProtection and the resource whitelist.
Previous TroyScripts documentation notes that webhook screenshots worked again after whitelist adjustments on Gemert RP. This does not guarantee identical results on every server.
sourceNote: Based on existing TroyScripts guidance (ts_bridge, ts_hostage, ts_keycard, ts_nlplates and ts_repairpoints), last checked November 6, 2026.
